headlines.title: White has 'exciting future' despite boos - Rice
headlines.description: Midfielder Declan Rice has defended his Arsenal team-mate Ben White after he was booed during England's win over Croatia at Wembley.

headlines.title: Arsenal target Nusa could cost £66m - Sunday's gossip
headlines.description: Arsenal could have to pay £66m for RB Leipzig's Antonio Nusa, Real Betis reject Chelsea's bid for Jose Morante, plus more.

headlines.title: Arsenal dig in for draw at Barcelona to extend unbeaten start
headlines.description:
Arsenal extend their unbeaten start to four matches in the Uefa Women's Champions League, as they produce a dogged display to hold Barcelona to a 1-1 draw at the Camp Nou. 
The point moves Renee Slegers' side into the top four, putting them in a great position to automatically qualify for the knockout stages.
